title: Game Logic Tiles
summary: Change one rule, step the world, and see why the game state changed in ten small puzzles.
user: Puzzle-loving beginners who want to learn game-state and rule logic by changing small playable systems before learning a programming language or engine.
smallest_useful_product: Static web app with grid puzzles, editable rule tiles, a step button, and shareable challenge seeds.
constraints: Age-appropriate deterministic challenges, no tracking, and no accounts.
